animation_description: Quick unarmed spirit palm strike in place: from a relaxed stance, draw the RIGHT hand back to the hip, step slightly forward with the left foot and thrust the right open palm straight forward at chest height, hold the strike for a beat, then recoil back to the relaxed stance. The other arm stays close to the body. Feet stay planted on the same spot. HEADLESS body ending at a short neck stump: never draw a head, face, hair or skull, and keep both hands below the shoulders. Same outfit, proportions and pixel scale. No weapon, no effects, no ground shadow.
